title: Returns Policy
content: We offer a 30-day return policy for all products. Items must be in original condition with tags attached.

title: Shipping Info
content: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days.

title: Product Care
content: Wash clothes separately in cold water. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low.

title: Order Tracking
content: You can track your order using the tracking number provided in your shipping confirmation email.

title: Payment Methods
content: We accept Visa, MasterCard, PayPal, and bank transfers. Credit card processing fees are passed to customers.

title: Warranty Information
content: All products come with a 1-year warranty covering manufacturing defects. Warranty claims must be submitted within 90 days of purchase.
